def build(ctx):
    a = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("b", b)
    
    # Temporary qubit for carry
    t = ctx.alloc()
    
    # First step: compute carries using Toffoli gates
    # Carry from bit 0 to bit 1
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], t)
    # Carry from bit 1 to bit 2
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], t)
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], t)  # This is wrong, need proper carry chain
    
    # Proper ripple-carry addition using Cuccaro et al. approach
    # We'll use a simpler approach with 3 ancilla qubits for carries
    
    # Allocate carry qubits
    c0 = ctx.alloc()
    c1 = ctx.alloc()
    c2 = ctx.alloc()
    
    # Compute carries
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c0)
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], c1)
    ctx.ccx(c0, a[1], c1)
    ctx.ccx(c0, b[1], c1)
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], c2)
    ctx.ccx(c1, a[2], c2)
    ctx.ccx(c1, b[2], c2)
    
    # Compute sum bits (a_i XOR b_i XOR carry_in)
    ctx.cx(b[0], a[0])
    ctx.cx(c0, a[0])
    ctx.cx(b[1], a[1])
    ctx.cx(c1, a[1])
    ctx.cx(b[2], a[2])
    ctx.cx(c2, a[2])
    
    # Clean up carries
    ctx.ccx(c1, b[2], c2)
    ctx.ccx(c1, a[2], c2)
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], c2)
    ctx.ccx(c0, b[1], c1)
    ctx.ccx(c0, a[1], c1)
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], c1)
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c0)
    
    ctx.free(c0)
    ctx.free(c1)
    ctx.free(c2)

    ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("b", b)
    
    # Cuccaro et al. ripple-carry adder
    # Use 3 ancilla qubits for carries
    c = [ctx.alloc() for _ in range(3)]
    
    # Compute carries (c[i] = carry out of bit i)
    # c[0] = a[0] & b[0]
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])
    # c[1] = (a[1] & b[1]) | (c[0] & (a[1] ^ b[1]))
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(c[0], a[1], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(c[0], b[1], c[1])
    # c[2] = (a[2] & b[2]) | (c[1] & (a[2] ^ b[2]))
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(c[1], a[2], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(c[1], b[2], c[2])
    
    # Compute sum bits: a[i] = a[i] ^ b[i] ^ c[i-1] (c[-1] = 0)
    ctx.cx(b[0], a[0])
    ctx.cx(b[1], a[1])
    ctx.cx(c[0], a[1])
    ctx.cx(b[2], a[2])
    ctx.cx(c[1], a[2])
    
    # Uncompute carries
    ctx.ccx(c[1], b[2], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(c[1], a[2], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(c[0], b[1], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(c[0], a[1], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])
